requirement: Pages tracy-web renders itself answer with hardening headers whose CSP still allows what the page loads, and the lane door POST /auth/otp/start spends the same per-inbox sign-in code budget as POST /login without spending /login's per-address one

oracle.ref: PR #834 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #805: GET /login answered 200 with none of X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Cache-Control, X-Content-Type-Options or Referrer-Policy (F-S1-020); six signed POST /auth/otp/start calls for one address answered 200 and mailed six codes, each replacing the last (F-S1-023).
oracle.invariant: 0 failures, 0 skipped. '#805: GET /login answers with every hardening header, in every language' passes: x-frame-options DENY, cache-control no-store, x-content-type-options nosniff, referrer-policy no-referrer, a content-security-policy with frame-ancestors 'none', for each of the eight web languages. '#805: every state of the sign-in page is hardened — 400, 401, 429 and the code step' passes. '#805: the provider buttons are forms, and the policy lets each one reach its provider' passes: form-action allows the Location of GET /signin/google and GET /signin/github. '#805: the device pages keep refusing a frame, and gain the rest — 200, 400, 401, 403' passes. '#805: the pages shown on a customer site’s address are hardened and stay framable' passes: no x-frame-options and no frame-ancestors on messagePage and unknownSitePage. '#805: the /docs fallback page is hardened; the built documentation is served as it is' passes: a static docs file carries no content-security-policy. '#805: the sixth code for one address in an hour is refused, mails nothing and keeps the last code' passes: 429 {code: 'RATE_LIMITED'}, 5 mails, the fifth code still verifies. '#805: one host mails more than thirty different inboxes — the lane door is not person-sized' passes: thirty-one lane calls from one address to thirty-one inboxes all answer 200 and mail. '#805: /login and the lane door spend ONE per-inbox budget, and separate per-address ones' passes: the sixth code for one inbox is refused through either door; thirty-one lane calls leave /login its thirty for the same address, and /login is refused at its thirty-first. '#805: an unsigned, expired or malformed request spends nothing from either budget' passes: 401 and 400 answers, 0 mails, then the full five per inbox and three hundred per host are still available. '#805: a rate table the database cannot answer refuses, it does not wave the mail through' passes: 429, 0 mails. '#805: with the beta gate on, an over-limit request gets the same quiet answer and queues nothing' passes: nine 200 {ok: true} answers, five enqueues, the stored code untouched. Since 11/10/2026 (J1.4, PR 1182) every hsts.test.mjs test passes: on Tracy's own https hostname every answer (a page, a JSON door, a 404, a relayed answer) carries exactly 'strict-transport-security: max-age=31536000' with no includeSubDomains or preload; a customer site hostname, a customer's own domain, the bare site domain and an http stand carry none.
